questions.q: Why does the email "ben@example.com " (with a trailing space) cause trouble when joining tables?
options: Trailing spaces are always removed automatically by merge
pandas cannot store spaces in strings
It will not equal "ben@example.com", so the join finds no match
Emails must be uppercase to be joined
questions.explain: String matching is exact. A trailing space makes two otherwise identical values different, so clean text with str.strip() before joining.

questions.q: Which chain converts "  ava chen" into "Ava Chen"?
questions.explain: strip removes the leading spaces and title capitalizes each word. Because each step returns a Series, they chain.

questions.q: What does raw["email"].str.split("@").str[1] return for the email "cara@shop.io"?
questions.explain: split("@") gives ["cara", "shop.io"] and .str[1] picks the second piece, the domain.

questions.q: You filter with df[df["name"].str.contains("a")] and get an error because the column has missing values. What is the fix?
options: Add na=False so missing values count as no match
Convert the column to numbers first
questions.explain: contains returns a missing result for missing text, which cannot be used as a filter mask. na=False turns those into False.
